# Kanchan Nath
> Full-Stack Engineer & Backend Specialist | Founder @ StudeQ

## Summary
Full-stack engineer and backend specialist pursuing B.Tech in Biotechnology at NIT Durgapur (CGPA 9.04). Experienced in designing high-concurrency Node.js/Express architectures, Redis caching & BullMQ pipelines, microservices, and AI-assisted educational tools. Founder of StudeQ (100+ users). Skilled in AI model training, prompt evaluation, and technical writing.

## Primary Tech Stack
JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, Python, HTML5 & CSS3, SQL
Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ
Frontend: React, Next.js, Three.js
